notes.title: Campfire Cooking 2.0 - Controller & Keyboard Support
notes.content:
Hello campfire chefs!

This update includes full support for both controller and keyboard. You'll be able to use any controller you own that's compatible with steam input, and any standard keyboard to control the skewers and the game menu.

[u]Menu Mappings:[/u]
Menu Access - Esc / Select Button / Start Button
Navigate Menu - Arrow Keys / WASD / Left Stick
Select Menu Item - Enter / Controller South Button (A)

[u]Gameplay Mappings:[/u]
Select/Switch Skewer - Spacebar / Controller South Button (A)
Move Skewer - Arrow Keys / WASD / Left Stick
Rotate Skewer - Q, E / Right Stick
Undo Move - Z / Controller East Button (B)
Restart Level - R / Controller North Button (Y)
Replay Cutscene - C / Controller West Button (X)

[u]Cutscene Mappings:[/u]
Progress Cutscene - Enter / Controller South Button (A)

~ Hawkes

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Campfire Cooking, 15% off!
notes.content:
Campfire Cooking is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

Campfire Cooking is a puzzle game about relaxing moments in nature, as you prepare meals over a warm fire. Follow a family's vacation to beautiful and exotic hiking trails. Listen to stories, toast marshmallows, simmer fondue or play with magnets until each meal is ready to eat.
